summary: Expose customer model configuration in the local application, reuse the existing provider gateway and budget controls, optionally persist remote keys with Windows current-user DPAPI, and safely restart the single service on the same port.
decision_refs: User request on 2026-09-27 to allow customers to configure different APIs in settings
Existing v0.2.6 custom-model launcher already validated the OpenAI-compatible text contract and endpoint/model identity
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested customer-configurable APIs from settings.
known_limitations: Custom providers must implement OpenAI-compatible chat/completions JSON mode and return usage data; vendor-specific SDKs are not added.
Generic custom providers remain text-only, and non-loopback LAN model endpoints are not accepted.
Only one model profile is active at a time; previously provider-scoped DPAPI credentials may remain available until explicitly replaced or forgotten.
